description: Back up and restore Hermes Agent data — config, secrets, skills, sessions, memories, cron, profiles. Creates portable tar.gz archives with SQLite consistent snapshots, JSON manifest, and integrity verification. Use when: "back up hermes", "restore hermes", "migrate hermes to new machine", "hermes backup", "hermes restore", "hermes 数据备份", "hermes 数据恢复".

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent validate API outcomes instead of assuming success?
Did the agent preserve evidence for request/response behavior and error handling?
